@graph.howPerformed: The treatment area is cleaned and numbing cream may be applied, then small amounts of Botox are injected into the targeted muscles with fine needles. Before treatment, avoid blood-thinning medications or supplements for a week and tell your dermatologist about any allergies. Afterwards, avoid lying down or vigorous exercise for 4–6 hours, and don't rub the area for 24 hours.

acceptedAnswer.text: Results typically last 3–6 months, depending on individual factors and the treatment area.
The procedure involves minimal discomfort, often compared to a small pinprick.

mainEntity.name: How soon will I see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Initial results appear within 3–5 days, with the full effect visible after about two weeks.
Mild redness, swelling, bruising or a headache can occur and usually settle within hours to days. Rarely, temporary eyelid drooping may occur.
